text: Between you, does this team have the skills the work needs?
Could you describe what success would look like for this team?
Is the work on this team shared out fairly?
Does the way this team runs its work suit the work you actually do?
Do decisions that affect this team actually get made?
Whatever gets thrown at this team, will you find a way to handle it?
Does this team regularly step back and look at how it works?
Does this team deliver work you can be proud of?
Do you feel like part of this team?
Are things outside this team making it harder to deliver right now?
If the team's goal got difficult, would you want to push on?
When something goes badly wrong, does this team recover well?
Do your team meetings help you get your work done?
When the work is not good enough, does anyone say so?
Does this feel like a team, or a group of people with the same manager?
When you hit something nobody knows how to do, can you get help?
Has anyone restated the team's goal recently enough to be useful?
Can you see what others on this team are contributing?
When work passes to you, do you have what you need to pick it up?
Once made, do decisions about this team stay made?
Does a setback make this team regroup or fragment?
When this team reviews its work, do people say what they think?
Does this team meet the commitments it makes to other people?
Would you miss this team if you moved somewhere else?
Is this team absorbing decisions that were made somewhere else?
Does the team's goal matter to you beyond it being your job?
Would this team take on something harder than its current work?
Do things get picked up cleanly as they move between people?
Do you know what a good quarter would look like for this team?
If you were choosing again, would you choose this team?
Are there enough of you for what you are being asked to deliver?
Is the team's goal specific enough to know when it is met?
Is your own contribution visible to the rest of the team?
Is the amount of coordinating in your week about right?
When your priorities change, do you find out why?
Between you, does this team have what it takes?
Do things this team agrees to change actually get changed?
Do you know how this team is performing?
Are you glad to tell people which team you are on?
Are outside demands pulling this team off what it planned?
Is the team's current goal worth the effort it will take?
Does this team believe it can handle what is coming?
Can you get an answer when you need one without losing a day?
Does this team see its own results, or only hear about them?
Does being on this team mean something to you?
Has this team been stable enough to work well together?
Would you and your teammates describe the goal the same way?
When someone here commits to something, does it get done?
Do you know what you are responsible for on this team?
When you raise something you cannot solve, does it come back to you?
Do you feel good about what is coming up for this team?
Do improvements this team makes tend to last?
Can you tell whether this team is getting better or worse?
Do you have a real connection with anyone on this team?
Does this team get enough warning about changes coming from outside?
Can you see why this work is worth doing?
When this team hits a wall, does it find a way through?
Do you know who decides what on this team?
Has the quality of this team's work held up over the last few weeks?
Is there anyone on this team you would go to with a bad day?
Is this team the right size for the work it does?
Do you understand how your own work moves the team's goal forward?
If someone here is struggling, do others step in?
Is it clear who owns a piece of work when it starts?
Is someone shielding this team from things it should not handle?
Has this team proved to itself it can do difficult things?
Is this team better at its work than it was six months ago?
Does this team hold itself to a high standard?
Would you want to work with these people again?
Is something outside this team slowing you down this week?
Do your own objectives sit comfortably alongside the team's goal?
Do you back this team to deliver the next big thing it is given?
Do handovers across locations or time zones work well?
Do you get to see how your work landed once it left the team?
Does this team feel like somewhere you belong?
Do you know who is on this team and who is not?
Does what you are measured on pull the same way as the team's goal?
Is anyone on this team carrying more than their share right now?
Are the tools you share making coordination easier?
Are decisions made quickly enough for this team to keep moving?
Does this team meet a hard challenge or brace against it?
Does this team try new ways of working, not just new work?
Can you see the difference your work makes to the people it is for?
Do you feel included in what this team does day to day?
Is this team shielded from noise it should not have to handle?
When priorities are traded off, is it clear which one wins?
Is this team's confidence holding up at the moment?
When two people could own something, does it get sorted quickly?
Is the bar this team works to still where it should be?
Have you felt more or less part of this team lately?
